bls_union_membership.transcription_note: Total and sector member counts are rounded independently by BLS; small apparent differences between sums are not errors.

aggregation.monthly_rates_and_jobs: arithmetic average of twelve monthly observations
aggregation.quarterly_flow_and_price_index: arithmetic average of four quarterly observations
aggregation.debt_stocks: fourth-quarter end-of-period observations divided by contemporaneous fourth-quarter GDP annualized flow
aggregation.trade_ratios: ratio of calendar-year average quarterly annualized flows
aggregation.price_income_indices: each series normalized separately to its 1990 annual mean
aggregation.causal_warning: These co-moving aggregates cannot identify policy, trade, or finance causal effects.

methodology_notes: The raw quarterly FRED export segregated end-of-period debt stocks from other quarterly data; the two CSVs are retained separately.
The FRED TDSP series in the October 2026 export has no observations before 2005; it is deliberately omitted from the 1990-2007 figure to avoid invented values.
A comparison between per-capita GDP and median household income is not an accounting decomposition; demographics and survey definitions differ.
Census income questionnaire and collection methods changed in 1993; a continuous Gini line is not a homogeneous measurement instrument.
FRED historical series are revised over time; these checked-in values freeze the observed October 2026 vintage, not original 1990-era releases.
